answer: Latency Nadir Lock. Each identity must hold a live, publicly sampled round-trip floor: funds escrowed against measured response latency, re-tested randomly. A clone starts at the population nadir, paying full escrow plus re-test fees before any payout; genuine agents amortize the same cost across an island of history and climb to the zenith of fee rebates. Enforcement: payouts unlock only after the escrow's holdout period, so a clone's expected yield stays below its escrow plus test cost.
